rules.name: Ambush
rules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

rules.name: Ambush Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Ambush. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Badlands Hunter
rules.description: When this model shoots/charges enemies over 9"/6" away, unmodified results of 1 to block hits from weapons deal 1 extra wound.

rules.name: Bane
rules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

rules.name: Bane when Shooting Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Bane on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Bounding
rules.description: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".

rules.name: Defense
rules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Defense Debuff
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which gets -1 to Defense rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

rules.name: Disintegrate
rules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking units where most models have Tough(9) or higher, this weapon gets AP(+2).

rules.name: Enhanced Badlands Hunter
rules.description: If this model has Badlands Hunter, enemies always take wounds on unmodified results of 1 to block from Badlands Hunter (instead of only when shooting/charging enemies over 9"/6" away).

rules.name: Enhanced Badlands Hunter Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Badlands Hunter. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Enhanced Violent
rules.description: If this model has Violent, enemies always take wounds on unmodified results of 1 to block from Violent (instead of only when shooting/charging enemies over 9"/6" away).

rules.name: Melee Slayer
rules.description: When charging, this model's weapons get AP(+2) if most models in the target have Tough(9) or higher.

rules.name: Precision Fighter Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get +1 to hit rolls in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Regeneration
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Repel Ambushers
rules.description: Enemy units using Ambush must be set up over 12" away from this model's unit.

rules.name: Stealth
rules.description: When units where most models have this rule are shot from over 9" away, enemy units get -1 to hit rolls.

rules.name: Stealth Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Stealth. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Tough
rules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

rules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
rules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

rules.name: Vengeance
rules.description: When this unit is fully destroyed, place as many Vengeance tokens on the unit that destroyed it as models with this rule in this unit at the beginning of the game. Friendly units get +X to hit rolls when attacking that unit, where X is the number of tokens on it.

rules.name: Violent
rules.description: When this model shoots/charges enemies over 9"/6" away, unmodified results of 1 to block hits from weapons deal 1 extra wound.

spells.name: Badland Frenzy
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get Enhanced Badlands Hunter once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Choking Waste-Fog
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 9 hits.

spells.name: Cracking Blast
spells.effect: Pick up to two enemy units within 18" in line of sight, which get -1 to Defense rolls once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Nomad Strike
spells.effect: Pick up to two enemy units within 6", which take 4 hits with AP(2) each.

spells.name: Psychic Flurry
spells.effect: Pick one friendly unit within 12", which gets Melee Slayer once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Wasteland Storm
spells.effect: Pick one enemy model within 24" in line of sight, which takes 2 hits with AP(2) and Disintegrate. This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1].
